description: List the software categories Toolradar tracks, with their tool counts, biggest first (50 per page). Filter by words with query, page with offset. A category's best-of page address is given only when that page exists.

context.description: Optional. In a few words, what the user is trying to do. No names, emails or other personal data.

min_tools.description: Leave out categories with fewer published tools (default 1)

offset.description: Skip this many: the answer gives next_offset when there are more

query.description: Words in the category name or slug, e.g. 'crm'

name: list_categories
